The '''Imperial Kolto Mining Facility''' was an underwater structure on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] used by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Third Galactic War]]. The mining facility was used to extract [[Kolto/Legends|kolto]] from the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] floor. The Imperial Kolto Mining Facility was attacked by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Invasion of Manaan]].<ref name="Borrow" />
